description: "The Advocate: A Novel" by Charles Heavysege is a fiction work written in the mid-19th century. The story opens in Montreal circa 1800 and centers around a skilled and eccentric lawyer—an advocate—whose tumultuous relationship with a woman named Mona Macdonald reveals themes of love, temptation, and societal expectations.
